nodes.label: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction
nodes.author: Heng Wang; Jielin Qiu; Wenting Zhao; Cheng Qian; Liangwei Yang; Jiawei Han; Heng Ji; Silvio Savarese; Shelby Heinecke; Huan Wang
nodes.rationale: Framed explicitly as both a deployable method and a null hypothesis: any scored selector that cannot beat prompt-protected random eviction at matched budget is not extracting usable information from its score.

nodes.label: Prompt-protection confound ablation
nodes.rationale: Re-running baselines with the prompt forcibly protected closes most of the reported gap between scored KV-eviction methods, showing prior comparisons were confounded by unequal implicit prompt protection rather than score quality.
